roadmap.bannerText: Client Dashboard (Bookings, HIPAA-private SOAP Notes, Progress Charts), Specialist Dashboard (Schedule with full address, SOAP Charting, Earnings) & Admin Dashboard.
roadmap.step1Desc: 12 relational tables, enums, triggers, indexes, and comprehensive RLS policies.
roadmap.step2Desc: Client, Specialist & Admin authentication, signup flow, and route protection.
roadmap.step3Desc: On-demand client requests, geolocation & specialty dispatch, atomic accept logic.
roadmap.step4Desc: Client progress & notes, Specialist schedule & earnings, Admin approval & mark-as-paid desk.
roadmap.step5Desc: Custom payment provider integration, automated PDF invoice generation & Resend email delivery.

banner.title: Comprehensive HealthTech Portals & Clinical Documentation
banner.description: Atomic Postgres RPC accept_specialist_match prevents double-acceptance race conditions using auth.uid(). Specialists see approximate vicinity until accepting, with full destination address revealed upon booking confirmation. Client portal displays scheduled sessions, HIPAA-filtered SOAP notes (client_visible = true), and mobility/pain recovery charts.
banner.paymentBoxDesc: Bookings track payment_status natively in Supabase. Admins can utilize the "Mark as Paid" action to settle bookings on demand.
